name: Rubber vulcanisation
summary: The heating of rubber with sulphur, so that it stays elastic in heat and cold. It made the rubber sole.
how: Heat the mixture to about 140 degrees Celsius.
Bond the cured sole to the canvas upper in the same oven.

origin.note: Charles Goodyear finds that rubber heated with sulphur stays elastic.

adoptions.via: The canvas basketball shoe has a vulcanised rubber sole that grips the court.
